title: What's New in Kotlin Jump
tagline: One cut per line, not per mention
summary: The plan that removes a declaration with its tests could return the same import range twice. Its only caller already guarded against it, so nothing visible changes.

highlights.title: A plan that no longer contradicts itself
highlights.description: One cut per import LINE rather than per mention. An island whose two dead members share a single `import com.x.Outer.Inner` produced the same range twice. The guard lived in the consumer; it belongs in the producer.

sections.heading: Fixes
bullets: The test co removal plan pushed one cut per mention rather than one per import line. No visible effect today, since the only caller deduplicates when it applies.

sections.heading: Notes
bullets: Removing a declaration and its tests together was the last edit with no witness on a real project. It has one now, six invariants deep, and all six hold across 61 findings.
The strongest of them: a file deleted whole must declare nothing another surviving test still names. Loosen the rule and it catches a Dagger component naming a test class.
